encoreEx.introTitre: Still in love with your ex?
encoreEx.introTexte: Twenty questions about what you feel for your ex, and about what the breakup took away from you. The two are measured separately: you can miss a relationship without still loving the person, and the other way around.
encoreEx.resultatLibelle: What you feel, in two scores
encoreEx.p_fini_t: You're not in love with your ex anymore
encoreEx.p_fini_d: Both bars are low. Your ex doesn't do much to you anymore, and their place hasn't stayed like a hole in your life: you can think about them without it hurting. What's left are memories, and it's normal to keep some from a relationship that mattered. If a detail made you doubt (a text, a song...), a little pang now and then doesn't mean you're still in love.
encoreEx.p_fini_a: You have room for someone else. If someone comes along, don't turn them down for the sake of a story that's behind you.
encoreEx.p_attachement_t: It's the missing talking, more than love
encoreEx.p_attachement_d: The gap is clear: what hurts is mostly what the breakup took away from you. You miss the evenings together, someone waiting for you at night, the way someone looked at you. Your ex was the one in that place, so it's their face that comes back. But if someone else, kind and thoughtful, showed up tomorrow, a good part of that missing would go away, and that's the sign you miss the relationship more than the person.
encoreEx.p_attachement_a: Don't text your ex to fill a lonely evening: you'd get the same relationship back, with the same problems. Fill what the relationship used to fill instead, with friends and evenings that aren't empty. Missing like yours fades a lot faster than love.
encoreEx.p_amour_t: Yes, you're still in love with your ex
encoreEx.p_amour_d: The love bar is clearly ahead of the missing one. What holds you is them, much more than being in a relationship: you still picture a future together, and a text from them would make your heart race. That's neither strange nor serious, and it can last a long time after a breakup.
encoreEx.p_amour_a: If the breakup came down to things that can change, you can tell your ex, once, clearly. If it came down to something deeper, or if your ex told you it's over, give yourself time and cut contact: that's what helps the most.
encoreEx.p_deux_t: Still in love, and still hooked
encoreEx.p_deux_d: Both your bars are high. You still love your ex for who they are, and at the same time the breakup left a big void, with the fear of being alone and the wish that they'd regret it. It's the most painful mix, because every lonely evening sends you back to them. It's also the one that makes people send texts they regret the next morning...
encoreEx.p_deux_a: Before deciding anything about your ex, take care of the void. As long as it's there, you can't know what you want. Surround yourself with people, look after yourself, and take the quiz again in a month: if the love bar holds while the missing bar has dropped, you'll know it's them.
encoreEx.p_melange_t: A little love is left, mixed with missing
encoreEx.p_melange_d: Neither bar dominates, and neither is very high. You still have some tenderness for your ex and a few memories that come back, but not the spark of the beginning. It's the most common result a few months after a breakup: feelings settle little by little, without vanishing all at once.
encoreEx.p_melange_a: Don't decide anything right away, things move a lot from one month to the next. Let a few weeks go by without checking up on your ex, then take the quiz again: most of the time, both bars will have dropped.
encoreEx.q1: Your ex asks you to try again tomorrow. You say...
encoreEx.q1b: Yes, but only if some things change.
encoreEx.q1c: I don't know, I'd need to think about it.
encoreEx.q2: What do you miss the most: your ex, or being in a relationship (the cuddles, the weekends together, someone waiting for you at night)?
encoreEx.q2b: Both, I can't tell them apart.
encoreEx.q3: You run into your ex in the street tomorrow. You feel...
encoreEx.q3b: A shock, and it stays with me all day.
encoreEx.q3c: A slightly awkward moment, nothing more.
encoreEx.q3d: Not much, I say hi and keep walking.
encoreEx.q4a: In the evenings and on weekends, when I'm alone.
encoreEx.q4b: When something reminds me of us: a song, a place.
encoreEx.q4c: All the time, even when I'm surrounded by people.
encoreEx.q5: Do you ever picture a future with your ex: living together, trips, plans?
encoreEx.q5a: Yes, often, and I still believe in it.
encoreEx.q5b: Sometimes, even though I know it's over.
encoreEx.q6: Imagine someone kind, funny and thoughtful asked you out tomorrow. Missing your ex would...
encoreEx.q6a: Probably go away for the most part.
encoreEx.q6c: Not change, it's my ex I want.
encoreEx.q7: When you meet someone, do you compare them to your ex?
encoreEx.q8: Would it feel good if your ex regretted it and came back for you, even if you said no?
encoreEx.q9: If you could say just one sentence to your ex tonight, it would be...
encoreEx.q9d: “I have nothing left to say to you.”
encoreEx.q10: Since the breakup, are you afraid of staying alone, of never finding anyone?
encoreEx.q11: Looking back, how do you see their flaws?
encoreEx.q11a: I loved those too, they were part of them.
encoreEx.q11b: I see them, but they seem pretty small.
encoreEx.q11c: I see them clearly, and they mattered.
encoreEx.q11d: They jump out at me, I wonder how I put up with them.
encoreEx.q12: When you think back on your relationship, you see...
encoreEx.q12a: Mostly the good times, as if there had never been a problem.
encoreEx.q12b: Mostly the good times, even though I know it wasn't working.
encoreEx.q12c: The good and the bad, about equally.
encoreEx.q13: What's happening in their life today (work, health, family): does it touch you?
encoreEx.q13a: Yes, I worry about them like before.
encoreEx.q13b: Yes, I'd like to know how they're doing.
encoreEx.q13c: A little, like for someone I used to know.
encoreEx.q14: Do you think about your ex mostly when you're not doing well (a rough day, a bad night out, exhaustion)?
encoreEx.q14a: Yes, almost only at those moments.
encoreEx.q14c: Not especially, I also think of them when things are fine.
encoreEx.q15: Your ex texts you tonight. How do you feel?
encoreEx.q15a: My heart pounds and I want to reply right away.
encoreEx.q15b: Happy, even if I wouldn't show it.
encoreEx.q15c: It does something to me, nothing more.
encoreEx.q15d: I don't care, or it annoys me.
encoreEx.q16: What you miss most about your life before is...
encoreEx.q16a: Our routines: the everyday stuff, the rituals, a well-ordered life.
encoreEx.q16b: The person I was with them.
encoreEx.q17: Could you be friends with your ex, without expecting anything more?
encoreEx.q17d: I don't want to, they don't interest me anymore.
encoreEx.q18: If your ex got into a relationship tomorrow, what would hurt the most is...
encoreEx.q18a: Feeling replaced, while I'm still on my own.
encoreEx.q18b: Them living with someone else what we had planned together.
encoreEx.q18d: Nothing in particular, it wouldn't do much to me.
encoreEx.q19: When you think of your ex, what comes to mind first?
encoreEx.q19a: Them: their voice, their laugh, the way they are.
encoreEx.q20: Before this relationship, how did you feel about being single?
encoreEx.q20a: Not great: I went from one relationship to the next, I don't like being alone.
encoreEx.q20b: Not always great, but I managed.
encoreEx.q20d: Very good, I like my freedom too.
